title: Primary Geography — How Waves Erode Rock
subject: geography
disclaimer: Illustrative conceptual activity score only, not a measured erosion rate; actual geology, time and wave exposure vary.

beats.label: Predict
beats.narration: Predict what happens when stronger waves strike weaker rock.

beats.label: Observe
beats.narration: Increase wave energy or lower rock resistance to compare the conceptual rate of erosion.

beats.label: Explain
beats.narration: Moving water and transported particles can wear rock; hardness and jointing affect how quickly erosion occurs.

check.question: All else comparable, which coastal rock erodes faster?
options: Weakly resistant rock under stronger waves.
Very resistant rock under gentle waves.
check.explanation: Wave energy and rock resistance both affect how rapidly material is worn away.
